contexts.text: First turned into a dull blue... SE 1302.
Their dwellings... are variegated with beautiful colours, crimson and blue.
Spheres... examined by means of blue bands... SE 3379.
A blue colour as of the night sky.

How it was with the good of the celestial Church was shown by a column coming down from Heaven, of an azure colour... This represented their first state; the azure colour their voluntary good... Afterwards the azure of the column passed into a dull flaminess...
(The Spirits of the isthmus of the brain) were represented by a man and a woman in a chamber, in a garment which was turned into a robe of an azure colour.
(The better kind of the Spirits of the colon) represented by a plaster wall... the upper part of which was of a colour inclining to blue.
The interwoven structure of the cuticles was shown representatively... It was of a blue colour.

My father appeared to me in a dream... When I awoke, there was seen coming down from Heaven a long roll... held together by most beautiful coloured textures of a bright blue... Such are the presents the Angels give each other.

The thoughts and speech of Societies... has sometimes been represented to me by clouds which rose and fell in the azure... Truths were represented by an azure colour mingled with a lovely shining whiteness... SE 2632.
(A man from the planet Mercury seen) who was clothed in a garment of a dim blue colour...

(The Angels in the first Heaven of Jupiter) appear dressed in sky-blue dotted with golden stars, for they believe that colour to be the very celestial colour itself. In the world, when they contemplate the starry heaven, they call it the abode of the Angels. Hence they love the azure colour.
The dwellings of (the inhabitants of Jupiter) were shown me... They are lined inside with a whitish blue bark dotted all round and overhead as with little stars, to be like the sky...
Good is there presented as round... and as to colour as blue, yellow, and red.
The azure of the sky = truth transparent from good.

The stones of this row derive [their colour] from the blue which is from red; for there is a blue from red and there is a blue from white. The blue from red sparkles inwardly from flaminess. This blue is what signifies the celestial love of truth. But the blue from white, such as prevailed in the stones of the next row, and which signifies the spiritual love of good, does not sparkle inwardly from flaminess, but from light. (Under Chrysoprase, Sapphire, and Diamond, see this reference.)
The sapphire was of an azure colour, like that of the sky.
Blue from white = spiritual good, or what is the same, the spiritual love of good... which is charity towards the neighbour...
That the cyanus is of a blue colour is known, and also the amethyst.
The colour of all the stones of this order approaches to bright white from blue. (They were beryl, onyx, and jasper, and = spiritual love of truth.)
The Divine sphere which encompasses the Lord... when represented in the Heavens... appears in the spiritual Kingdom blue like dark blue.
The seats in the second row were covered with blue silk.
Hyacinthine is a blue colour, Described. This colour and azure are dearly loved by the celestials, but green not so much, except in so far as it partakes of blue.
A man seen dressed in a garment of bluish white...
His being dressed in a bluish white garment signified that he was an upright Spirit...
This blackness was turned into a beautiful blue... which was resplendently blue. I therefore inferred that they were from Jupiter.
Two or three temples (of the planet Jupiter) shown. They were coloured. They have a special love for a brilliant and beautiful blue...
A little child, or an Angel as a little child, seen wearing a garland of resplendent blue flowers...
When corporeal things have been reformed... they are at first represented by... a blue colour, with points...

On the right were most beautiful representations distinguished by blues and colours thence derived, because the right eye represents affections, and the colours are not derived from a bright lucidity, but from flaminess.

The blackness of these profaners is derived from blue, but the blackness of the former kind... from red, because the latter profane the goods of the Word and of the Church, but the former their truths; for red derives its signification from the sun, and blue from the sky.
